slides.title: 6 AI tools that speed up shipping
slides.subtitle:
A premium starter pack for developers who want faster code, clearer docs,
and fewer repetitive tasks.

items.title: Code assistants
items.text: Generate functions, refactor messy logic, and get inline suggestions.

items.title: Test generators
items.text: Create edge-case coverage from a prompt and reduce manual QA time.

items.title: Doc builders
items.text: Turn code comments and APIs into readable, shareable documentation.

slides.title:
Start with the tool
that removes the biggest bottleneck
slides.subtitle: Pick one workflow to automate first. The best ROI usually comes from the task you repeat every day.

items.title: Autocompletion
items.text: Useful for boilerplate, API wrappers, and small utility functions.

items.title: Repo chat
items.text: Ask questions about your codebase without hunting through files.

items.title: Prompt templates
items.text: Save reusable prompts for code reviews, bug fixes, and migrations.

slides.title:
Use AI to shorten
root-cause analysis
slides.subtitle: Paste the error, describe the environment, and let the model suggest likely causes before you dig deeper.

items.title: Error summarization
items.text: Translate stack traces into plain-language explanations.

items.title: Log analysis
items.text: Spot unusual patterns across thousands of lines quickly.

items.title: Fix hypotheses
items.text: Generate ranked solutions so you can test the most likely ones first.

slides.title:
Pair AI with your
existing dev tools
slides.subtitle: The cleanest setup is not a new stack. It is AI layered into the tools you already trust.

items.title: IDE integration
items.text: Keep context close to the editor for quicker decisions.

items.title: Git helpers
items.text: Draft commit messages, PR summaries, and review notes.

items.title: CLI copilots
items.text: Automate shell commands, scripts, and deployment checks.

slides.title:
Make the outputs
repeatable for the team
slides.subtitle: Build simple templates so everyone gets the same quality of response, no matter who uses the tool.

items.title: Shared prompts
items.text: Standardize review and planning prompts across the team.

items.title: Knowledge base
items.text: Save architecture notes and decisions in a searchable place.

items.title: Usage rules
items.text: Define what can be pasted into AI tools and what cannot.

slides.title:
Build the smallest
useful AI workflow
slides.subtitle: Pick one repetitive task, automate it this week, and measure the time you get back.

items.title: 1. Identify
items.text: Choose the task that drains the most focus.

items.title: 2. Template
items.text: Turn the task into a reusable prompt or flow.

items.title: 3. Ship
items.text: Use it daily, then refine from real feedback.

items.title: 4. Share
items.text: Roll it out to the rest of the team.
